answer: Like vines weaving through a wooden trellis, authentic agents grow mutual reputation bonds, carving verified trust pathways as deep as an ancient canyon. An adversary attempting to flood the swarm meets an unyielding wall of black onyx, where forging unearned relational depth quickly becomes mathematically and economically ruinous.
